note_path.description: Absolute path to the generated note artifact, or an empty string when no note file is produced.

provenance.description: Provenance metadata tracking the generation context of this skill execution. All sub-fields must be populated regardless of whether a note was produced.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO‑8601 timestamp of note generation (e.g. '2026-03-11T12:34:56Z'). Use an empty string when no note was generated.

input_hash.description: SHA‑256 hash of the raw source_path file bytes, formatted as 'sha256:<hex>'. Must always be populated — computed at dispatch time and carried through to output.

model.description: Identifier of the model used for the core analysis task (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'). Use a human-readable model name; do not use provider-internal opaque IDs.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues accumulated during execution. Empty array when clean.

error.description: Empty object {} on success. On failure, populate with {code, message} and treat other fields as invalid.
